description: This file contains benchmark code for quantized GEMM (general matrix multiplication) operations, including sparse variants, using QNNPACK library. It defines classes for setting up and tearing down benchmark tests, and registers multiple benchmark configurations for different CPU architectures.

classes.name: Q8GEMM
classes.description: Benchmark fixture for standard quantized GEMM operations, managing data setup and teardown.

classes.name: Q8GEMMSparse
classes.description: Benchmark fixture for sparse quantized GEMM operations, managing sparse data setup and teardown.

classes.name: Q8GEMM_Op
classes.description: Template class for specific GEMM operation configurations.

classes.name: Q8GEMMSparse_Op
classes.description: Template class for specific sparse GEMM operation configurations.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes data buffers and parameters for the benchmark.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up data buffers after benchmark execution.
